audit_title: Historical Weather Forecast Availability & Vintage Integrity Audit

current_repository_state.archived_nwp_blocker: Archived DWD ICON GRIB2 NWP model runs (vintaged by model_initialization_time and forecast_lead_time) require multi-terabyte CDC/ECCODES binary storage or unauthenticated external API egress (historical-forecast-api.open-meteo.com) which is blocked in isolated sandbox environments (WinError 10013).
current_repository_state.synthetic_nwp_status: DEPRECATED & REMOVED. Prior synthetic Gaussian AR(1) perturbation has been removed from production paths per senior data governance mandate (Rule 5 & Rule 15: Never fabricate NWP data).

mode_1_persistence_weather.description: Uses weather observations strictly known at forecast issuance time (T <= forecast_origin, e.g. T - 24h).
mode_1_persistence_weather.leakage_risk: ZERO LEAKAGE. No contemporaneous or future weather enters model inputs.

mode_2_load_only.description: Completely excludes meteorological inputs, relying exclusively on calendar/temporal and issuance-bounded load lags.

mode_3_archived_nwp.description: Genuine archived DWD ICON 00z/06z/12z NWP runs matched by valid_time = delivery_time and issue_time <= forecast_origin.

vintage_integrity_rules.rule_1_gate_closure_constraint: weather_issue_time <= forecast_origin (12:00 CET on Day D-1)
vintage_integrity_rules.rule_3_fallback_transparency: When archived NWP vintages are unavailable, the system transparently logs persistence weather and does not misrepresent it as NWP performance.
